item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Chaba will move in the general direction of the coast of western Guangdong in the next couple of days and intensify gradually. There will be strong winds with swells over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. Its associated outer rainbands will also bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, the weather is expected to remain unsettled over the coast of Guangdong next week.

Weather: Cloudy to overcast with squally showers and thunderstorms. There will be swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
